extDescription.message: Sorts downloads into project folders, gives them consistent names and keeps a sources list for you. Built for assignments.

idleHint.message: Start a project and every download goes into its folder with a running number, and its source is listed for you. With no project, HushDown only fixes meaningless names like "image931.png".

groupActive.message: This tab is in the "$1" group. Downloads from here go to the "$1" folder.

projectCount.message: $1 files · sources list in the folder: $2

projectEmpty.message: No files yet. Your next download lands here.

useTabGroupsLabel.message: Use tab group names as projects

notificationsLabel.message: Notify me when a download finishes

sourcesNote.message: HushDown updates this list automatically with every download.

permHint.message: Add each page's full address and title to the sources list? Chrome calls this "read your browsing history"; HushDown only looks at the tab you download from and sends nothing anywhere.
